+  <para id="eip-422"><emphasis effect="italics">Principles of Macroeconomics 3e</emphasis> aligns to the topics and objectives of most introductory macroeconomics courses. The text uses conversational language and ample illustrations to explore economic theories, and provides a wide array of examples using both fictional and real-world scenarios. The third edition has been carefully and thoroughly updated to reflect current data and understanding, as well as to provide a deeper background in diverse contributors and their impacts on economic thought and analysis.</para>
   <section id="eip-887">
     <title>Coverage and scope</title>
     <para id="eip-id1169327261430">In response to faculty feedback and to ease transition to a new edition, <emphasis effect="italics">Principles of Macroeconomics 3e</emphasis> retains the organization of the previous editions. The book covers the breadth of economics topics and also provides the necessary depth to ensure the course is manageable for instructors and students alike. We strove to balance theory and application, as well as the amount of calculation and mathematical examples.  </para>
